sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for Vitamin B12 testing when billed with designated conditions. Certain services are also subject to specific frequency limitations.

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
children.content: Total Vitamin B12 Testing Limitation UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement of the following procedure codes for total Vitamin B12 testing, up to once every three months. Procedure Code(s) 82607 Homocysteine Testing UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement of the following homocysteine testing procedure code(s) for the condition(s) listed below: Procedure Code(s) 83090 Condition(s) Vitamin B12 deficiency.
